Exposure

Average holdings 12.7 stocks; average weight 37% in stocks and 63% in GOLDBEES/LIQUIDBEES; regime risk-on on 46% of sessions; turnover 12.7x a year; costs 1.65% a year.

  • Benchmarks are NIFTY price indices (no dividends, about 1.2–1.5% a year less than total return). Strategy stock prices are not dividend-adjusted either.
  • Sharpe: daily % returns, sqrt(252), 0% risk-free rate. The performance cards below compute Sharpe on rupee P&L, which grows with the book, so the two differ.
  • The dev/holdout split is the original README's, kept for comparison. Every rule was tuned on the F&O universe, not on Nifty 500.
